check_in_completed.description: True when the shop owner completed the morning inventory check-in.

name.description: Product name as spoken by the shop owner.

quantity_estimate.description: Approximate quantity remaining; use best estimate from conversation.

unit.description: Unit spoken by the owner, e.g. bags, cartons, pieces.

running_low.description: True when the owner says stock is low or almost finished.

supplier_mentioned.description: Supplier name if the owner mentions where they buy this item.

last_purchase_price.description: Last purchase price in shop currency if stated on the call.

is_new_item.description: True when the owner introduces a product that was not in the prior inventory list. The ledger adds it as a new product row.

owner_notes.description: Optional free-text notes from the owner about the shop today.
